newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich airport authority breaks even for first time.
newsitem.headline: Munich airport authority breaks even for first time.

text.p: Flughafen Muenchen GmbH, the operator of Munich Airport (MUC), said it broke even for the first time last year and expects to show an overall profit in 1997.
The airport improved pre-tax operating profits by 35 percent to 190 million marks in 1996 based on provisional figures, an authority statement said.
Taking interest payments, property sales and other special factors into account, Flughafen Muenchen moved out of the red five years after the opening of the new Munich airport, it added.
Total revenue increased 10 percent to 810 million marks with revenue from landing and handling fees rising 10 percent to 455 million marks, the authority said.
Landing and handling fees per aircraft movement, however, were reduced by one percent last year. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
